plan.summary: This 4-week block is a short, high-value off-camp build for a boxer training S&C once per week with 30-minute sessions. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body lift so future loading can be guided cleanly, and the main training work starts in Week 2. The focus here is simple power first, then foundational strength, then brief trunk and upper-back support without adding excess fatigue that could interfere with boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic lower-body power and foundational full-body strength with simple, repeatable work that fits around boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power gradually while keeping total lifting fatigue low enough to protect skill work.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep the strength base and shift more emphasis toward faster, sharper outputs with lower fatigue.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a box height you can land on quietly and confidently. Reset between reps and focus on fast takeoff and stable landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if box setup is awkward. Jump for height, stick the landing, and reset each rep.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bodyweight only. Start from a controlled quarter squat and explode straight up.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Take several gradual warm-up sets, then build to one hard but clean top set. Stop if technique breaks down and log the load and reps.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. This establishes your baseline for future percentage-based squat work.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if back squat setup or confidence is not there yet. Build to one hard clean set of 5 reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if it feels more comfortable on the shoulders and upper back while keeping the same squat pattern.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Move with control and squeeze at the top. Keep the torso quiet and stop with 2 reps left in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a neutral or close grip and keep the chest tall.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Brace well and keep the pull smooth rather than jerking the weight.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Only roll out as far as you can keep ribs down and lower back flat. Slow out, controlled return.

substitutionOptions.name: Stability Ball Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the ab wheel is too difficult. Keep the trunk braced throughout.

substitutionOptions.name: Cable Crunch
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a load you can control without pulling with the arms.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Keep every rep explosive and crisp. If jump height drops or landings get noisy, stop the set there.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if box setup is limited. Treat every rep like a max-effort jump.

substitutionOptions.name: Trap Bar Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if you can keep it light and fast. Jump with control and reset each rep.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Move each rep with control on the way down and intent on the way up. Leave 2 reps in reserve on each set.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the strongest clean set of 5 from today so next week can progress without grinding.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row

substitutionOptions.name: T-Bar Row

exercises.name: Farmer Carry

substitutionOptions.name: Trap Bar Carry
